shortBio.en: Talking Heads bassist; melodic funk lines; Tom Tom Club with Chris Frantz.
shortBio.zh: Talking Heads 贝斯手；旋律 funk 线条；与 Chris Frantz 做 Tom Tom Club。

whyHub.en: Talking Heads groove → Tom Tom Club pop: rhythm section as separate logo.
whyHub.zh: Talking Heads groove → Tom Tom Club 流行：节奏组作为独立 logo。

body.en:
Born 1950. Bass on Heads 1975–91. Genius of Love (Tom Tom Club, 1981) shows the side project as hit factory.

Hub: Heads art-funk and dance-pop share one player.
body.zh:
1950 年生。1975–91 在 Heads 司贝斯。Genius of Love（Tom Tom Club，1981）证明支线可成热单工厂。

枢纽：Heads art-funk 与舞曲流行共用同一乐手。

note.en: With Chris Frantz; project not in chronicle.
note.zh: 与 Chris Frantz；项目未入编年史。
